history.change: Initial milestone lists. Setup is separate from mathematical completion. Later phases are provisional and will be refined with their sources and statements.

Added the reader-facing account of models, computational rules, and what a QED proof certifies, linked from HQ and the outline. Exact declarations and the regulator route remain open; no mathematical milestone status changed.

Added a reusable orchestrator launch brief for Phase 1, including bounded delegation, exact-statement approval and freezing, resource discipline, and evidence-based reporting. No orchestrator was launched and no mathematical milestone status changed.

Phase 1 preparation began. Pinned the primary source (Srednicki draft, chs. 58 and 62-64) and the secondary source by SHA-256 with an untracked cache. Adopted the source's conventions, selected the one-loop route (Pauli-Villars photon, photon mass, Feynman gauge, on-shell scheme, energy-first Minkowski integral), mapped the derivation with numbered obligations, and recorded findings F-1 to F-10. Took the Mathlib inventory, pinned Lean/Mathlib v4.35.0, and initialized the package. Proved the first infrastructure: the Minkowski form and the Weyl gamma matrices with the Clifford relation. An independent refute-first review of the four Phase 1 documents was addressed before landing; SPEC.SOURCE and SPEC.ROUTE are marked done on that evidence. No declaration is approved or frozen; author rulings P-1 and P-2 are pending.

Recorded the author's rulings: the model starts from a momentum-space Wick expansion at order e^3 (D-8); both magnetic-moment definitions (the source's wave-packet definition and the vertex response) are to be formalized and proved equivalent (D-9, new obligation O-24); the repository is licensed under Apache-2.0 (D-10). No milestone status changed.

Proved the gamma-matrix product identities (38.19)-(38.20) and the Gordon identity (38.18) for arbitrary solutions of the Dirac equations (QED/Algebra/Gordon.lean). L1.PROJECTION is marked in_progress; nothing is complete.

Proved the contraction identities (47.18)-(47.21) at d = 4 from the anticommutators (QED/Algebra/Contraction.lean). Defined the Dirac adjoint and closed-form on-shell spinors, and proved the Dirac equations (38.1), (38.16), the normalization (38.17), and the Gordon identity for spinors (QED/Algebra/Spinor.lean). Equality with the boost definition (38.12) is pending. No milestone is complete.

Proved obligation O-7: the loop-energy integrals evaluated on the slit plane by analytic continuation from the real axis, which replaces Wick rotation (QED/Integration/EnergyIntegral.lean). L1.INTEGRAL is marked in_progress; the M1 integral definition itself is still open.

Author approved packet 1 as written (D-11). Froze four definitions (electron and Pauli-Villars photon propagators, the (62.40) integrand, the energy-first integral) and one theorem goal (well-definedness of the epsilon -> 0+ limit, DRAFT_SORRY, quarantined with an empty provider), bound by QED/Frozen/manifest.json. Installed the frozen-anchor guard and ABI hashes. Recorded process gap F-12 (unfrozen infrastructure in the closure; packet 1b proposed). SPEC.STATEMENTS is in_progress.

Author approved packet 1b as written (D-12). Froze the five infrastructure definitions in packet 1's closure (QED.Minkowski.metric, dot, lower; QED.Dirac.gamma, slash) one per file under QED/Frozen/Algebra/ with unchanged export names; pp.all output unchanged by the move, packet 1 bytes and ABI hashes unchanged. All manifest closures are now transitive over frozen files. F-12 resolved. Corrected the slash citation in CONVENTIONS.md to (37.24). SPEC.STATEMENTS remains in_progress (packet 2 pending).

Proved packet 1's theorem (E) QED.OneLoop.vertexLimit_existsUnique: Feynman parameters (O-5), Fubini and closed-form energy integrals (O-6), a uniform (1 + |l|)^-5 Pauli-Villars bound from D >= 3/4 min(M^2, m^2) on shell, and dominated convergence (O-10). New modules: QED/Integration/{FeynmanParameter,ShiftedEnergyIntegral,LoopBounds}.lean, QED/OneLoop/VertexAlgebra.lean, QED/Algebra/OnShell.lean, and the provider. Sealed the frozen anchor with the provider (D-13: implicit data binders and by-assumption auto-params). An independent refute-first audit found no defect; standard axioms only. L1.MODEL and L1.INTEGRAL remain in_progress.

Infrastructure toward packet 2 (no source-facing declaration): moved the analysis of (E) into QED/OneLoop/VertexEnergyFirst.lean (the provider is now a short assembly) with the limit representation and the eps = 0 boundary values; Fubini at eps = 0 and the x <-> 1-x symmetry (VertexClosedForm); 3D spatial integrals and isotropy (Integration/SpatialIntegral); the numerator contraction and on-shell reduction (63.14)-(63.17) (OneLoop/NumeratorReduction); gamma traces and the independence of the two on-shell vertex structures (Algebra/FormFactorIndependence). Packet 2 drafted, independently reviewed, and submitted for author approval.

Proved the closed form of the one-loop vertex limit (VertexSpatial, VertexFormFactors): the sandwich between on-shell Dirac solutions equals e u'[A gamma^mu - (i/m) B S^{mu nu} q_nu] u with explicit A and B = (e^2/8 pi^2) int dF3 (x3 - x3^2) m^2 (1/D_mgamma - 1/D_Lambda). Proved the joint limit of the normalized B, equal to 1 as m_gamma -> 0+, Lambda -> oo, q^2 -> 0+, with its eps-delta form (PauliLimit). These carry the analytic content of packet 2's goals; packet 2 still awaits author approval.

Author approved packet 2 as written (D-14). Froze lorentzGen (moved, pp.all unchanged), (F) vertexOneLoop with its characterization (F') sealed by its provider, (G0) IsFormFactorPair, and the theorem goals (G) decomposition exists-unique and (I) the one-loop anomaly headline as DRAFT_SORRY with quarantined providers. Shared facts are in QED/OneLoop/FormFactorPair.lean.

Sealed packet 2's (G) and (I) with their providers; an independent refute-first audit found (F'), (G), (I) PROVED. (I) gives F2 -> e^2/8pi^2 = alpha/2pi (C1 = 1/2) for the (62.40) diagram under D-5, jointly as q^2, m_gamma -> 0+, Lambda -> oo. L1.PROJECTION, L1.INTEGRAL, L1.LIMITS, and L1.COEFFICIENT are marked done with that scope; L1.VERTEX (Wick derivation with counterterm), L1.OBSERVABLE (magnetic moment, D-9), and L1.ASSEMBLY remain planned.

Proved the equality of the closed-form spinors with the source's boost construction (38.12) (Algebra/SpinorBoost), and the analytic facts for charge renormalization (OneLoop/ChargeRenormalization: the loop's A depends only on q^2 on shell, the loop sandwich at p' = p is e A(0) u'gamma u, and A(q^2) is continuous at 0+). Packet 3 (charge condition (63.1), counterterm shift O-8, and F1(0) = 1) drafted, independently reviewed, and proved transiently against its exact text.

Author approved packet 3 as written (D-15). Froze (J) vertexFunction (62.39), (K0) IsChargeNormalized (63.1)-(63.2), and the theorem goals (K) exists-unique Z1, (N) counterterm shift (O-8), and (M) F1(0) = 1 at fixed regulators as DRAFT_SORRY, with quarantined providers using QED/OneLoop/ChargeCondition.lean.
Sealed packet 3's (K), (N), (M); an independent refute-first audit found them PROVED. O-8 (the counterterm shifts only F1) is now a theorem, and F1(0) = 1 holds at fixed regulators.

Infrastructure for the response definition of the magnetic moment (D-9): exact Breit-frame spinor identities for the y-current with momentum transfer along x and spin up (Algebra/BreitFrame, obligation O-22); the Breit sandwich of the vertex function, i e q (Z1 + A + B), and its unique linear-in-q coefficient mu = e(Z1 + A(0) + B(0))/(2m) (OneLoop/MagneticResponse); the joint regulator limit of B at q^2 = 0 and its continuity at fixed regulators (OneLoop/MagneticMoment). Packet 4a (response definition and the Lande factor) drafted and proved transiently against its exact text; independent review in progress.

Author approved packet 4a as written (D-16). Froze the spinor definitions beta, bar, restSpinor, spinor (moved, pp.all unchanged), (R0) IsResponseMagneticMoment, and the theorem goals (R) exists-unique mu and (R') the Lande factor g -> 2(1 + alpha/2pi) as DRAFT_SORRY with quarantined providers.

Sealed packet 4a's (R) and (R'); an independent refute-first audit found them PROVED. The one-loop Lande factor g = 4 m mu / e of the response magnetic moment tends to 2(1 + alpha/2pi) with the charge-normalized counterterm, jointly as m_gamma -> 0+ and Lambda -> oo. L1.OBSERVABLE is in_progress: the source's wave-packet definition and the equivalence O-24 (packet 4b) remain.

Author approved packet 4b as written (D-18). Froze (W0) oneParticleMomentum, (W1) packetCurrentDensity, (W2) packetNormSq, and (W3) sourceMagneticMoment, the source's wave-packet definition of the magnetic moment (64.4)-(64.9) with the packets of D-17, and the theorem goals (W4) O-24 (absolute convergence of the position integral and the packet limit equals the response moment) and (W5) the source Lande factor g -> 2(1 + alpha/2pi), as DRAFT_SORRY with quarantined placeholder providers.

Infrastructure for packet 4b's (W4): smoothness of parametric integrals over a compact set (Integration/ParametricSmooth), and C-infinity smoothness of the form factors A(q^2) and B(q^2) on (-4m^2, oo) at fixed regulators (OneLoop/FormFactorSmooth).

Infrastructure for (W4) and (W5): the packet amplitude F(k, k') = w(k') w(k) M(k', k) of the frozen current density (OneLoop/PacketAmplitude); the first position moment of a two-momentum Fourier integral of a smooth compactly supported amplitude converges absolutely and equals (2 pi)^3 (i/2) int (d_k - d_k')F on the diagonal (Integration/PacketMoment, with Fourier inversion at the origin); and a conditional helper deriving (W5) from the packet limit of (W4) and the sealed (R), (R') (OneLoop/SourceLandeFactor).

Infrastructure for (W4): smoothness of on-shell spinors and adjoints (Algebra/SpinorSmooth); the closed form of the plane-wave matrix element M(k', k) and C-infinity smoothness with compact support of the packet amplitude (OneLoop/PacketAmplitudeSmooth).

Sealed packet 4b's (W4) and (W5); an independent refute-first audit found them PROVED. For the source's wave-packet definition of the magnetic moment, the undamped position integral converges absolutely and the source moment tends to the response moment as the packet narrows (O-24), and g -> 2(1 + alpha/2pi). L1.OBSERVABLE is done.

Author decided the design of L1.VERTEX (D-19): the 1PI vertex is defined from the Wick contractions of the full counterterm Lagrangian (62.2)-(62.3), counterterms counted as order e^2; canonical one-loop routing with the M1 integral at fixed epsilon; general contraction combinatorics. L1.VERTEX is in_progress (statement preparation).

Author approved packet 5 as written (D-20). Froze 24 definitions of the Wick derivation of the vertex (vertex kinds, contractions, fermionic sign, 1PI, routing, vertex factors, amplitude, value, wickVertex) in QED/Frozen/Wick/, and the theorem goals (W1) wickVertex_eq (O-1, O-2) and (W2) tendsto_wickVertex as DRAFT_SORRY with quarantined placeholder providers. The frozen-anchor guard now accepts abbrev, inductive, structure and instance as definitional keywords.

Infrastructure for (W1): the energy-first integral is invariant under translations and reflection of the loop momentum, with no integrability assumption (Integration/EnergyFirstShift); each of the six vertex-correction contractions has value equal to the energy-first integral of the frozen (62.40) integrand, with the routing, the index contraction to gamma^rho S gamma^mu S gamma^nu, and the shift (Wick/ChainValue). Author decided the design of L1.ASSEMBLY (D-21): one headline theorem from the Wick vertex; prove both sides of O-3 (residues; the photon side needs a fermion-loop regulator ruling); fresh-checkout audit, Comparator challenge and errata ledger.

Sealed packet 5's (W1) wickVertex_eq and (W2) tendsto_wickVertex; an independent refute-first audit found them PROVED. The order-e^3 1PI part of the Wick expansion with all counterterms is i Z1 e gamma^mu + the regulated one-loop diagram (62.40) with coefficient one, the fermion-line ordering and no closed-loop sign (O-1, O-2), and its epsilon -> 0+ limit is the vertex function. L1.VERTEX is done. Author chose Pauli-Villars regulator fermions in the Wick model for the photon side of O-3 (D-22).

Author decided the design of O-3 (D-23): the full LSZ amplitude of the connected order-e^3 three-point function (leg corrections included), equal to u'-bar V u epsilon under the on-shell conditions, which fix delta2, delta_m, delta3 uniquely; and a general successor of the Wick model with arbitrary external fields and the regulator fermions.

Published docs/ERRATA-AND-DEVIATIONS.md (five Srednicki misprints, two Kaplunovsky, twelve deviations; each erratum checked twice). Author approved packet 6a (D-24): froze the general Wick model in QED/Frozen/WickModel/ (32 definitions: arbitrary external fields, Pauli-Villars regulator fermions as a flavoring summed inside the loop integrand, 1PI and connected n-point functions) and the theorem goal (Y1) that packet 5's vertex is the special case, as DRAFT_SORRY.

Sealed packet 6a's (Y1) wickVertex_eq_onePIFunction; an independent refute-first audit found it PROVED. Packet 5's vertex is the (1,1), order-3 1PI function of the general Wick model, for all regulator-fermion parameters. Author chose the literal covariant form of the on-shell conditions (D-25); packet 6b-1 (the self-energy and vacuum-polarization existence-and-uniqueness goals) is in review.

Infrastructure for packet 6b: the one-loop two-point integrands (WickModel/TwoPoint); the general model's self-energy and vacuum-polarization functions at order e^2 equal the counterterm trees plus the energy-first integrals of these loop integrands, with the closed-loop sign and the Pauli-Villars flavor sum (WickModel/TwoPointClassification*); and the epsilon -> 0+ limit of the self-energy loop is i(A(p^2) pslash + B(p^2) m) below both photon thresholds, with explicit Pauli-Villars Feynman-parameter forms of A and B, smooth in p^2 (WickModel/SelfEnergyEnergyFirst, SelfEnergyLimit).

Author approved packet 6b-1 (D-26): froze (Z1) selfEnergy_existsUnique and (Z2) vacuumPolarization_existsUnique (limits with the covariant decompositions, integrability conjuncts, regulator masses M1, M2 > m) as DRAFT_SORRY. The (Z1) provider carries the landed proof; the (Z2) proof is in progress.

Sealed packet 6b-1's (Z1) selfEnergy_existsUnique; an independent refute-first audit found it PROVED. The one-loop self-energy from the Wick expansion has the covariant form A(p^2) pslash + B(p^2) m below both photon thresholds, with A, B the Pauli-Villars form of (62.33) minus the counterterms.

Sealed packet 6b-1's (Z2) vacuumPolarization_existsUnique; an independent refute-first audit found it PROVED. Under the Pauli-Villars conditions the one-loop vacuum polarization from the Wick expansion is transverse in the epsilon -> 0+ limit, Pi(k^2)(k^2 g - k k) with Pi(s) = -delta3 + (e^2/2pi^2) int x(1-x) sum_f c_f log(M_f^2 + x(1-x)s); integrability fails if either condition is dropped.

Author approved the electron half of packet 6b-2 (D-27): froze selfEnergyAB (Z3) with its characterization (Z3', sealed), selfEnergySlash (Z4, Sigma(pslash) = A(-pslash^2) pslash + B(-pslash^2) m), IsElectronOnShell (Z5, Sigma(-m) = Sigma'(-m) = 0), and the theorem goal (Z6) that these fix delta2, delta_m uniquely, as DRAFT_SORRY with its proof in the provider.

Sealed (Z6) electronCounterterms_existsUnique; an independent refute-first audit found (Z3') and (Z6) PROVED. The on-shell conditions Sigma(-m) = Sigma'(-m) = 0 fix delta2 = a - 2m^2 a' + 2m^2 b' and delta_m = b - 2m^2 a' + 2m^2 b' uniquely (a, b the loop form factors at -m^2), matching the Pauli-Villars analogue of (62.34)-(62.38).

Author approved the photon half of packet 6b-2 (D-28): froze vacuumPolarization (Z7) with its characterization (Z7', sealed), IsPhotonOnShell (Z8, Pi(0) = 0), and the theorem goal (Z9) that it fixes delta3 uniquely (delta3 = Pi_loop(0)), as DRAFT_SORRY with its proof in the provider.

Sealed (Z9) photonCounterterm_existsUnique; an independent refute-first audit found (Z7') and (Z9) PROVED. Pi(0) = 0 fixes delta3 = Pi_loop(0) = (e^2/12 pi^2) sum_f c_f log M_f^2 uniquely, the regulated analogue of (62.24). Packet 6b is complete.

Author ruled on the packet 6c design (D-29): background-field photon leg with the vacuum-polarization insertion, iterated LSZ limit along any approach to the mass shell, and the magnetic moments restated with the LSZ amplitude.

Author approved packet 6c-1 (D-30): froze (L1) lszAmplitude_existsUnique, the existence and uniqueness of the LSZ amplitude of the electron current (the iterated limit of the sandwiched connected three-point function, with the integrability of every one-loop connected contraction), as DRAFT_SORRY with a stub provider.

Sealed (L1) lszAmplitude_existsUnique; an independent refute-first audit found it PROVED. The LSZ amplitude of the electron current exists and is unique, and equals ubar' V u + e q^2 D(q^2) Pi(q^2) ubar' gamma u: the electron legs drop out by the on-shell conditions, and the photon leg is the vacuum-polarization insertion. 25 helper modules: the decomposition of the connected three-point function, the off-shell vertex limit, the leg limits and the integrability of every connected one-loop contraction.

Author approved packet 6c-2 (D-31): froze lszAmplitude (L2) with its characterization (L2', sealed), the closed form (L3), the LSZ charge condition (L4) and its equivalence with (K0) (L4'), the LSZ response magnetic moment (L5) and its equivalence with (R0) (L5'), the LSZ packet current density (L6) and source magnetic moment (L7), and the analogue (L7') of (W4); the four theorem goals as DRAFT_SORRY.

Sealed (L3), (L4'), (L5') and (L7'); an independent refute-first audit found them and (L2') PROVED. The LSZ amplitude is ubar' V u + e q^2 D(q^2) Pi(q^2) ubar' gamma u; the LSZ charge condition and both LSZ magnetic-moment definitions are equivalent to packets 3, 4a and 4b, and the LSZ source moment equals packet 4b's at every packet width. Packet 6c is complete.

Author ruled on the headline design (D-32): stated from the general Wick model with on-shell counterterms and the LSZ amplitude; no photon on-shell condition (holds for every delta3); F2 and both Lande factors in one statement; fixed Pauli-Villars regulator fermions.

Author approved the headline packet (D-33): froze IsLSZFormFactorPair (H0, sealed), its existence and uniqueness (H0'), and the headline theorem lszAmplitude_pauli_landeFactor_limit (H): from the general Wick model with on-shell counterterms and the LSZ amplitude, F2 within eta of alpha/2pi and both Lande factors within eta of 2(1 + alpha/2pi) near the regulator limit. H0' and H as DRAFT_SORRY, with their proofs in the providers.

Sealed the headline theorem (H) lszAmplitude_pauli_landeFactor_limit and (H0'); an independent refute-first audit found both PROVED. From the general Wick model with on-shell counterterms and the model's own LSZ amplitude: near m_gamma -> 0+, Lambda -> oo, F2 is within eta of alpha/2pi and both magnetic-moment definitions give g within eta of 2(1 + alpha/2pi), for every delta3. L1.MODEL done (the regularized order-e^3 Wick model with Pauli-Villars regulator fermions, sealed and audited); L1.ASSEMBLY in progress (remaining: Comparator challenge and fresh-checkout audit, D-21).

Prepared the Comparator challenge for the headline (D-21): QEDChallenge.lean (Mathlib only; 64 definitions copied verbatim from the frozen declarations under the QEDChallenge prefix, with Params and VertexKind keeping their library names; five theorems), QEDSolution.lean (the same copies, bridge lemmas to the library, proofs of the five theorems), comparator.json. Constant-by-constant comparison: 128 of 128 match. The frozen-anchor guard accepts sorry only in the Challenge named by comparator.json and forbids importing it.
